deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Intersect submitted the treasury withdrawal on behalf of the vendor, and the abstract, motivation, and rationale were sourced from the vendor's approved Intersect budget-process proposal.

The proposal says Wirex will deliver open-source payments infrastructure including smart contracts, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, wallet support, and an API ecosystem layer.
The proposal says the solution will enable Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
The proposal states Wirex has 7 million users, over 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.
The proposal states the withdrawal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

The proposal states funds will be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury-management smart contracts, with TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature permissions, milestone-based disbursement controls, and external oversight entities identified.
The proposal references a dashboard, smart-contract guide, GitHub repository, and audit reports for community auditability and verification of the treasury-management framework.

summary: The document describes a 3,961,538 ada treasury withdrawal for Wirex payments infrastructure, with detailed budget routing and oversight mechanics, but the main adoption and commercial-impact claims are largely asserted in the anchor text while governance-process and smart-contract-management claims are more externally checkable.
